mapper.sql: SELECT c.*, COALESCE( cfg.status, CASE WHEN c.default_enabled THEN 'ENABLED' ELSE 'DISABLED' END ) AS status, COALESCE(cfg.sort_order, c.default_sort_order) AS sort_order, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bookkeeping_entry e WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.category_code = c.code AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS active_entry_count FROM bookkeeping_category c LEFT JOIN bookkeeping_user_category_config cfg ON cfg.category_id = c.id AND cfg.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bookkeeping_category ( code, scope, owner_user_id, entry_type, name, icon_key, default_enabled, default_sort_order, create_request_id ) VALUES ( #{code}, #{scope}, #{ownerUserId}, #{entryType}, #{name}, #{iconKey}, #{defaultEnabled}, #{defaultSortOrder}, #{createRequestId} )

INSERT INTO bookkeeping_user_category_config ( user_id, category_id, status, sort_order ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{status}, #{sortOrder} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), sort_order = VALUES(sort_order)
